historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: FLAGGED: Equity CAGR is deeply negative (-6.1% over 3yr, -2.6% over 5yr) while Revenue CAGR is +10.5%/+13.1% and FCF CAGR is +10.0%/+13.2%. This is a buyback artifact, NOT business deterioration. Adobe has repurchased shares under $25B+ authorizations, mechanically shrinking book value. FCF CAGR (3yr: 10.0%) is used instead, which aligns with management FY2026 guidance.

base.description: Adobe sustains ~10% growth consistent with management guidance, decelerating as AI competition incrementally weighs on Creative Cloud pricing power. FCF margin held stable at ~41%. WACC of 10% reflects investment-grade balance sheet, beta ~1.2, risk-free rate ~4.3%, and moderate AI disruption risk premium.
base.growth_rationale: Y1 10% anchored to guidance midpoint. Y2 9% reflects continued Firefly/Acrobat momentum and Semrush contribution. Y3-Y4 deceleration as AI competition from Canva/OpenAI/Google incrementally pressures SMB/consumer tiers. Y5 5% reflects normalization. Terminal 3% consistent with long-run nominal GDP growth.

bull.description: Firefly enterprise adoption accelerates, Acrobat AI Assistant captures significant share of the knowledge-worker PDF market, GenStudio becomes a go-to enterprise content supply chain platform, and Semrush proves accretive. FCF margin expands toward 44%. WACC of 9% reflects reduced execution risk as AI leadership becomes entrenched.
bull.growth_rationale: Y1 15% reflects H1 FY2026 actual momentum (~12% YoY) plus Semrush contribution (~$200M incremental) and accelerating Firefly enterprise book of business. Bull case assumes AI book of business reaches $2B annualized run rate by FY2027. Y5 7% reflects durable moat in professional creative and enterprise marketing automation. Terminal 3.5% reflects premium to GDP given secular content creation tailwind.

bear.description: AI commoditizes creative tools faster than expected. Canva/OpenAI/Google force pricing concessions on Creative Cloud individual and SMB tiers; subscriber churn accelerates. Experience Cloud growth stalls below 5%. FCF margin compresses to 38%. Higher WACC of 12% reflects elevated execution and disruption risk. Terminal growth of 2%.
bear.growth_rationale: Y1 6% reflects guidance conservatively discounted for execution risk. Y2-Y3 deceleration as generative AI lowers demand for professional Creative Cloud subscriptions. Y4-Y5 approaching terminal as structural headwinds dominate. Lower terminal growth (2%) reflects risk that Adobe's growth normalizes toward GDP given intensifying AI-native competition.

sanity_check.diagnosis: No trip. Base IV $446 implies 26.7x trailing P/E and 18x P/FCF, BELOW Adobe's ~35x historical median P/E. The current market price ($197.43) sits below even the bear-case IV ($273.55).
sanity_check.fix_applied: None required. Multiples are within historical bounds.
